---
title: "An empty page open-graph entry keeps the site's image and size"
open-graph:
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<meta property="og:image" content="https://example.com/mark.jpg">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:height" content="892">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:width" content="1200">'
        - []
---

The page declares `open-graph:` with no value, so the site's open-graph image and its declared size are used.
